typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		COUNTY_NAME as string,
		EMAIL_RECIPIENTS as string,
		COUNTY_CRITERIA as string,
		COUNTY_CODE as string,
		FILENAME_TEMPLATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(STATUS_FLAG = 0) ~> ADDSTATUSFLAG
ADDSTATUSFLAG split(length(ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(COUNTY_NAME),' ')),' ')) > 0 && !(isNull(COUNTY_NAME)), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(VALID,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@VALID sink(input(
		COUNTY_NAME as string,
		EMAIL_RECIPIENTS as string,
		COUNTY_CRITERIA as string,
		STATUS_FLAG as integer,
		FILENAME_TEMPLATE as string,
		COUNTY_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		COUNTY_NAME,
		EMAIL_RECIPIENTS,
		COUNTY_CRITERIA,
		STATUS_FLAG,
		FILENAME_TEMPLATE,
		COUNTY_CODE)) ~> OLEDBDestination
